title: Marin Rose Society (Nanette Londeree) — Pruning Roses

common.applies_to: Bush rose; recently planted / restraint period, and (documented, not operationalised) first-year light shaping
common.preserved_uncertainty: Not an institutional source. Distinct article from PKR-SRC-000031 (also Marin Rose Society/Londeree, "Before You Buy New Roses") — different URL, different content, treated as a separate source per this project's established practice (see PKR-SRC-000004/000016 for the equivalent Oregon State University precedent).
mil_references: ARC-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-01, AF-1 (Moderate) — restraint period for full pruning; explicitly exempts dead-wood removal from the newly-planted restriction
ARC-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-01, AF-4 (Low, documented, not operationalised) — first-year roses may be pruned lightly

content.source_type: Recognised horticultural publication (rose society; named Master Rosarian author)
content.identity: Marin Rose Society, Nanette Londeree (Master Rosarian), "Pruning Roses," https://www.marinrose.org/care-basics/pruning-roses/, accessed during FRD-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-03 research
content.relevance: The only source found that explicitly exempts dead-wood removal from the newly-planted pruning restriction, and separately addresses light first-year shaping.

provenance.note: Initial LIL load: gardener-facing content transcribed from the Published submission package (Founder Review Rendering). Earlier versions are preserved in git history of that package.
